name: Peppermint, Chamomile, or Ginger Herbal Tea
whyItWorks: Natural antispasmodics that calm smooth muscle cramping in the intestinal tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep pure peppermint, chamomile, or ginger tea bags in hot water with honey.
watchOuts: Always check herbal tea labels to ensure zero Earl Grey/bergamot, hibiscus, or citrus peel fillers
